title: SOTA Survey + Karpathy Lightning Bridge Gap

proposals.title: Karpathy Lightning Feature Bridge: Extract + Inject 0.21218 Feature Subset
proposals.motivation: The Karpathy Lightning burst (P100 TabICL) produces a 0.21218 Brier individual with n_feat=106. This is being injected via REMOTE_PROMOTE into S14 but not translating — S14 stays at 0.22431 after 3+ injections. The feature indices from the lightning individual capture optimal feature combinations for this dataset. Extracting and seeding CPU islands with these 106 indices as high-priority starting individuals would bridge the GPU->CPU gap without requiring GPU compute.
proposals.implementation: 1. Read latest karpathy lightning output (scripts/gpu-burst/lightning-output/ or Lightning.ai artifacts). 2. Extract best individual's feature_indices array (106 entries from ~3365 candidates). 3. POST each survivor island /api/config with seed_individual containing those indices + catboost model_type. 4. Monitor next 5 cycles for brier improvement vs baseline.
proposals.expected_impact: If 30% of lightning feature advantage transfers to catboost on CPU, expect brier drop from 0.22248 toward 0.220x range. Non-destructive — seeds 1 individual into 60-member population.

proposals.title: Logistic Regression Brier 0.199 — Add LR to GA Model Pool
proposals.motivation: Published 2026 research (MDPI uncertainty-aware NBA, Preprints.org Apr 2026) shows logistic regression achieving Brier 0.199 on NBA datasets — better than our fleet best 0.22073. Our previous sota-2026-04-19 flagged this. The GA has never included logistic_regression in its model_type pool. Adding it costs 1 line in island init and lets the GA discover if LR is competitive on our feature set.
proposals.implementation: Add 'logistic_regression' to MODELS dict in island app.py with C=0.1/1.0/10.0 as GA-tunable hyperparams + saga solver + L1 penalty. Include in crossover/mutate model_type choices. GA will naturally select it if it performs.
proposals.expected_impact: Low implementation cost, potentially high reward. LR is extremely fast to train (5-10x faster than xgboost), enabling larger populations or more generations per cycle.

proposals.title: SHAP-Protected Core Features — Prevent GA from Dropping Top-15
proposals.motivation: Preprints.org 'Key Factors Influencing NBA Game Outcomes' (Apr 2026 v2) and XGBoost+SHAP PMC paper consistently identify: home_win_pct, away_win_pct, elo_difference, rest_days_delta, back-to-back indicator, last-10 form. These 6-15 features are getting randomly dropped during mutation. SHAP on our best individuals would likely confirm these are our top features too. Making them protected from deletion would prevent wasted search.
proposals.implementation: 1. Run SHAP on current best individual from S18 (extra_trees, 51 features, brier 0.22248). 2. Identify top 15 feature indices by mean |SHAP|. 3. Add 'protected_feature_indices' list to island config via /api/config. 4. Modify mutation to skip deletion for protected indices.
proposals.expected_impact: Accelerates convergence by 20-30% — eliminates generation cycles wasted on poor feature combinations.
